classification: internal raw field evidence; get_info output includes device identifiers
interpretation: After power-on, drive fault cleared and nodes and measured feedback became online; left and right actual rpm stayed zero.
get_can_diag showed canBusOff=true as historical evidence and canBusOffActive=false at query time.

get_info reported uptimeMs=83490 and boDiag=[83234,3]. The latest A-Box CAN1 Bus-Off event was only about 256 ms before this query; the fault therefore recurred after power-on rather than remaining only as an old lockout.
Normal status canBusOff remained true and movement stayed blocked. No motion command was issued. Power output was turned off after the observation.

observations: Across an approximately 12-second and a separate approximately 45-second zero-rpm power-on observation, A-Box's last Bus-Off timestamp remained 84414 ms since boot; no new Bus-Off was recorded.

The current canBusOff gate cleared, canBusOffActive was false, three nodes and measured feedback were online, powerReady became true, and both actual rpm stayed zero. The historical get_can_diag.canBusOff remained true by design.

wyse3040 PCAN received no frames during its attempted passive capture after the termination change; the A-Box reports and operation results, not that empty capture, support the no-new-Bus-Off finding.
Power output was turned off after each observation; no motion command was issued.

followup_with_can1_and_wyse_termination_.wiring_as_reported_by_user: CAN1 and wyse3040 termination enabled; drive termination disabled
observations: In about 45 seconds of zero-rpm power-on, A-Box's last Bus-Off timestamp stayed 84414 ms since boot and current canBusOff stayed false in all 89 power-on status samples; canBusOffActive was false at the final query.

A short driveFault indication appeared in 2 early samples and cleared; powerReady was true in 85 samples, all three nodes and measured feedback were online at the end, and both actual rpm remained zero.

wyse3040 PCAN passively captured 7865 CAN frames including Node 1 and Node 2 traffic; its CAN controller stayed ERROR-ACTIVE with bus-off, error-pass, error-warn and bus-errors counters at zero. Its RX packet count rose from 17320 to 25185.
Power output was turned off after the test; no motion command was issued. A 60-ohm physical termination measurement was not made and cannot be inferred from software diagnostics alone.

remote_control_10rpm_followup.preflight_failure: The first script invocation lacked the service's PATROL_CHASSIS_CONTROL_DB_PATH; it failed before power-on or motion and its cleanup power_off succeeded. The retry used the deployed database path and enabled flag.
observations: After a valid platform permit, the production control session sent a 10-rpm target; device responses reported acceptance but status showed left/right measured 0/1 rpm and stopped, so actual wheel motion was not verified.

wyse3040 captured acknowledged Node 2 SDO writes 60FF=+10 and 68FF=-10. Its CAN controller had zero bus-off and error counters. Node 2 status word changed to 0x04BF with the fault bit set before CAN frames stopped at epoch 1790560694.504584.
Platform chassis status became stale and the session ended. Automatic power_off cleanup timed out; an older powerOutputOn=false status report was insufficient to prove current physical power state.

A subsequent get_info succeeded with uptimeMs=164125 versus 2381144 before the test, proving an A-Box restart; the reset reason field was 0 and did not identify the cause. Its reported output was false.

At the user's request, no further automatic power-off was used. One zero-speed power-on followup left output on; get_can_diag read driveObjects[1]=4, driveSw=0x20D8, canBusOffActive=false, and 0/0 rpm. Status driveFault stayed true, powerReady=false, and get_bench_steering feedbackGateMask=512 with coordinateValid=false.
No further motion target was sent after this fault. A-Box restart cause and physical wheel behavior remain unverified.

The latest status before the steering request reported output on, driveFault=true, powerReady=false, safetyReady=false and 0/0 measured rpm. The steering profile and range flags were true, but the full motion gate was not ready.

The read-only get_bench_steering operation was sent and timed out without a device response; at evidence capture its last chassis report was more than 100 seconds old. wyse3040 still passively received CAN frames and had no bus-off or controller errors.
No steering permit, steering target, drive target or power-off command was sent during this followup. Output was left on at the user's request.

At epoch 1790562369.1523318 the device reported uptimeMs=179523, implying a new A-Box boot around 2026-09-28 10:23:09 China time. This is later than the post-drive restart, so another restart occurred.

The platform worker saw V4 heartbeats about every five seconds through 10:23:02, then none until 10:23:27, a 25-second gap covering the inferred boot time. The worker's unattributed-product log entries are duplicate processing of the same device V4 heartbeat and serve only as timing evidence.
On a subsequent live check the device heartbeat age was 3.45 seconds and chassis status age was 0.02 seconds; the device was online and reporting powerOutputOn=true, three nodes online and 0/0 rpm.

get_info resetReason=0 did not identify the reset cause. No power or motion command was sent by this diagnostic check; administrator power_on operations were visible in the platform queue after the inferred boot time.

validation: Two-terminator zero-rpm observation had no new Bus-Off, but the first 10-rpm control test failed with Node 2 drive fault and A-Box restart. Steering followup could not proceed because the motion gate was not ready and a read-only diagnostic timed out. Another A-Box restart occurred around 10:23:09 China time. Motion acceptance is blocked pending drive, power and command-response diagnosis. User requested avoiding repeated power-off. Formal dist remains 0.2.36.
